title: Coded authentication failures
responsibility: Create stable authentication error codes with their mapped HTTP status.

inputs.name: AuthFailure.constructor.code
inputs.description: Declared authentication failure code used for the error message and status.

inputs.name: authFail.code
inputs.description: Declared authentication failure code to throw.

outputs.name: authFail
outputs.description: Never returns; throws AuthFailure for the supplied code.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Error named AuthFailure with code, mapped status and a generic Hub auth message rather than provider details.
